scope: W01 4B sourced reference materials and property-resolution contracts; no spatial sampling, thermal evolution, EOS, rheology or calibration

reference_conditions.unsupported_conditions: refuse extrapolation; reference coordinates are retained per datum

independent_source_anchors.locator: Table 3 granite literature range at 20 C

mixture_rules.conductivity_default: harmonic/arithmetic bounds; no unjustified central estimate
mixture_rules.porosity: may be added only to grain properties with an explicit fluid; not to already-bulk rock references
mixture_rules.thermal_expansion: no scalar mixture invented without a selected mechanical model
mixture_rules.radiogenic_heat: unknown is not zero; reference populations or explicit U/Th/K assay only

acceptance.source_unit_transcription: independent table anchors and retained raw units/ranges
acceptance.mixtures: exact rational synthetic quantities and independent two-phase examples
acceptance.validity: separate nominal/reference/interval meaning; no high-T/P extrapolation
acceptance.ownership: immutable metadata and numerical buffers, stable identities, bounded gather
acceptance.persistence: canonical self-contained library and geological-case snapshots, exact round trip, corruption refusal and fresh-process backup restoration
